# Decision log

For the decisions that bind today, one line each, read [Decisions in force](in-force.md). This index lists every record.

These records preserve why choices were made. The status below is copied from each original record, not inferred from code. An accepted decision may be partly implemented, and an older status may lag delivery. Use [implementation status](../reference/status.md) and the [current protocol](../reference/connector-protocol.md) when building a connector.

Since [D102](D102-a-decision-is-provisional-until-something-outside-the-repository-has-tested-it.md) a record is `proposed`, `provisional` (chosen, but tested by nothing outside the repository) or `accepted`, and later `superseded` or `withdrawn`; the status starts with that word; a one-screen adjustment is not a numbered record; and a number is taken from this index on the day the change lands on `main`.

Historical numbering collisions: **D37, D38, D39, D44, D45, D46, D85, D96, D99, D100, D101** each identify more than one file. The full filename is the unique key. Keep existing filenames and links; never interpret a bare collided number without its title. No decisions were renumbered or accepted by this index.

## Add a decision

Use [TEMPLATE.md](TEMPLATE.md) and a new unused number (currently D122). Include status, date, area, decision, rationale and what it replaces. Preserve earlier decision bodies; record supersession explicitly. Refer to the full filename when a number is ambiguous. Update the implementation-status guide when delivery changes, say what changed and why in the commit message, and run `bun run docs:generate` followed by `bun run docs:check`. The generated context map includes every record.
